messages:
ryan: Quick flag  noticed a sudden bump in token spend for a handful of tenants after the new routing weights rollout. our cost dashboard shows a step up but it's fuzzy which routing change caused it. anyone who owns rollout-preview math around?

sophia: I saw the spike too. looks correlated with increased fallback to model:open-large in the morning window. we currently only show aggregate estimate in the UI, not per-variant impact.

diego: we should surface a per-variant "projected $ delta" in the preview. simple approach: simulate 1h of traffic using current route distribution and multiply by per-token price diff. formula:

```
proj_delta = sum_over_variants((new_prob[v] - baseline_prob[v]) * expected_invocations * avg_tokens[v] * price_per_token[v])
```

maya: love that. UX asks: keep it lightweight (one-line $/hr) and an expandable breakdown (tokens, cache effect, price per model). also include a confidence indicator (low/medium/high) because sampling is noisy.

ryan: also we need cache behavior in that sim. important because some variants change prompt sealing and kill hit rate. propose adding a heuristic: effective_tokens[v] = avg_tokens[v] * (1 - cache_hit_rate[v]) + cached_prefetch_cost.

sophia: for telemetry folks, here's a quick query to pull variant-level samples (not perfect but useful):

```
SELECT model_variant, approx_percentile(tokens, 0.5) as median_tokens, avg(cache_hit::int) as hit_rate, count(*) as samples
FROM invocation_samples
WHERE route = '/generate' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model_variant;
```

sophia: that'll let us estimate avg_tokens and hit_rate per variant.

diego: would be great to also show "worst-case" cost if cache drops (e.g., due to small prompt funk). show that as a toggle in preview.

maya: governance ask: we should make soft-budget an opt-in default for early rollouts. default: alert at +25% spend for 10m and auto-pause if +100% for 5m. we can tune later.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout-preview v0.63 promoted to staging at 2026-06-11T09:12Z.

ryan: follow-ups: (1) add $/hr projected delta + expandable breakdown, (2) show per-variant cache hit assumption and allow override, (3) soft-budget controls in rollout modal, (4) add a "compare to 7d median baseline" checkbox.

sophia: I'll wire the telemetry queries and add a small service endpoint that returns per-route per-variant stats for the preview. will sample to keep cost down.

diego: I'll prototype the server-side sim and the worst-case toggle. can we reuse existing price table? price_per_token is in billing.pricing_v2.

maya: I'll mock the UI in Figma and include the one-line estimate + confidence badge. will also add copy for the soft-budget tooltip. linking the mock in next message. :memo:

sophia: created a short dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/variant-costs — adds median tokens + hit rate per variant. will open access for PMs.

ryan: great. can someone make a follow-up ticket? prefer INF-8810 with acceptance criteria: preview shows $/hr estimate, expandable tokens/cache/model breakdown, soft-budget controls, toggle for worst-case sim, telemetry endpoint documented.

diego: filing INF-8810 now. pinging @sophia @maya for acceptance.

maya: thanks all. small ask: include an "explain" link that shows the assumptions used in the sim (time window, sample rate, price table version) so we don't get blamed for being magic.

sophia: agreed, will include a short assumptions panel.

ryan: ok locking this down. we'll defer auto-roll for >10 tenants until we have at least 3 weeks of telemetry matches. thanks team.
